title: The Slow Race
synopsis: Jake enters the annual Slow Race, where the last one across the finish line wins, and discovers that going slow is the hardest thing he has ever done.
plot:
Turtle Princess hosts the Slow Race: whoever crosses the finish line last, without ever stopping, wins. Jake enters because he assumes it will be easy, and Lumpy Space Princess enters because she heard there was a trophy. Finn is the referee, holding a very slow stopwatch.

Jake quickly learns that stretching lets him move fast, not slow. Every time he tries to inch forward he overshoots. LSP, meanwhile, is naturally drifting at exactly the right speed while complaining about it. A snail is also competing and is the clear favorite. Party Pat and the Party Bears set up along the route and hold a rave that lasts four days because the race takes that long.

On day four, Jake has slowed himself down to the point of nearly not existing, stretched so thin he is mostly an idea. He and the snail and LSP approach the finish together. LSP gets distracted by a text and floats over the line first. Jake and the snail cross at the same instant. The snail is declared the winner because Jake blinked. Jake is fine with it. He has learned what it feels like to be a snail, and it is peaceful.
transcriptText:
Turtle Princess: Welcome to the Slow Race. Last across the line wins. If you stop, you're out.
Jake: Easy. I'm the laziest guy in Ooo.
Lumpy Space Princess: I'm here for the trophy. Is it gold? It better be gold.
Turtle Princess: It's a turtle.
Lumpy Space Princess: Ugh. Whatever. I'm in.
Snail: [nods]
Finn: On your marks. Get set. ...Slow.
[Jake tries to inch forward and shoots ten feet ahead.]
Jake: NO. No no no.
Finn: Still moving, still legal!
Lumpy Space Princess: [drifting] This is so boring. Why is this so boring. I'm winning though, right?
Finn: You're doing great, LSP.
[Day two. Party Pat has set up speakers along the track.]
Party Pat: We're gonna party until this race is over, man.
Finn: It might be a week.
Party Pat: Then we party for a week.
[Day three. Jake is stretched impossibly thin.]
Jake: [barely audible] I think... I'm mostly... a concept now.
Finn: You're still moving. Keep going, buddy.
Snail: [nods, very slowly]
[Day four. The finish line.]
Lumpy Space Princess: Oh my glob, Melissa texted me— [floats across the line]
Finn: LSP's out! She crossed first!
Lumpy Space Princess: WHAT? THIS IS RIGGED.
[Jake and the snail approach the line together. Jake blinks.]
Turtle Princess: The snail wins! Jake blinked.
Jake: [reassembling himself] I blinked?
Finn: You blinked, man.
Jake: [lying down] That's okay. I get it now. I get snails.
Snail: [nods]
Mr. Cupcake: Nobody told me this was a race. I was just walking.
